description: Is this merchant safe to depend on? Audits up to ten x402 endpoints in one call and returns a verdict — ready, partially ready or not ready — with the specific blockers. Checks each endpoint serves a payable challenge with well-formed terms and a declared input schema, and adds the cross-endpoint check no single probe can make: whether every endpoint pays the same recipient. Never pays anything. Pay 25000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

endpoints.description: Up to 10 endpoints. Give a descriptor with the request that endpoint actually needs — probing a paid API with an empty POST reports it unpayable when it is merely undocumented here.

oneOf.description: Endpoint URL. Probed with POST and an empty body, which only suits endpoints that accept one.

body.description: The canonical request body this endpoint requires, when it requires one.

expected_pay_to.description: Optional. The recipient you expect every endpoint to pay; a difference becomes a blocker.

name: x402_merchant_readiness_audit
title: x402 Merchant Readiness Audit
